module.name: Melodic Table of Elements
module.purpose: Interactive sonified periodic table — maps chemical element properties (period, group, block) to musical tones via triadic harmonic synthesis. Fork of leonard-seydoux's project, adapted into the TriadicFrameworks resonance ecosystem.

modules_linked: elements.py → make_sounds.py → sounds/*.mp3 — data model → synthesis → audio assets
elements.py → make_html.py → index.html — data model → page generation → interactive UI
snippets/ → make_html.py — HTML/CSS/JS components assembled into index.html
data/periodic-table.csv → make_sounds.py — source properties drive frequency computation
session_context.drift: minimal (stable periodic table data, fixed synthesis algorithm)
session_context.format: python + html + css + javascript + csv + mp3

structural_grammar.dimensional_envelope: D3 (triadic harmonic synthesis: fundamental × overtone × decay)

imports: External: leonard-seydoux/melodic-table-of-elements (original fork source, CC BY 4.0)
exports: Triadic harmonic synthesis example (D3 applied to chemistry)

submodules.name: Sounds
submodules.purpose: 118 MP3 tones (sound-1.mp3 through sound-118.mp3), one per chemical element, generated by make_sounds.py.

files.purpose: Module front door — interactive periodic table overview, sonification methodology (period×f0 fundamentals, group×overtones, block-based harmonics), CC BY 4.0 license, and contribution notes.
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license text for the melodic table project.
Git ignore rules for the melodic table workspace.
Element data model — Python definitions for periodic table elements with properties used in sound generation and HTML rendering.
HTML generator — builds the interactive periodic table page from element data, assembling header/footer/styles/audio snippets into index.html.
Sound generator — synthesizes element-specific tones from period-based fundamentals and group-based overtones, applies Tukey windowing and exponential decay, outputs MP3 via ffmpeg.
Generated interactive periodic table — dark-themed web interface where each element plays its sonified tone on hover/click.
Source data — periodic table element properties (atomic number, symbol, name, period, group, block, atomic mass, etc.) used by make_sounds.py and elements.py.
Audio playback engine — JavaScript handling element hover/click sound triggers, fade-in/out, and concurrent playback management.
HTML header snippet — page title, meta tags, and stylesheet/script includes assembled by make_html.py.
HTML footer snippet — credits, license notice, and closing tags assembled by make_html.py.
Stylesheet — periodic table grid layout, element cell styling, hover effects, and responsive design rules.
